title: He Has Done Good To Me

request.style: English, female solo voice with warm vibrato, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, soft percussion, hopeful and gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How long must I carry worries within me
With grief in my heart all the day
How long will my enemy triumph over me
Casting a shadow across my way

[Pre-Chorus]
Look at me and answer, LORD my God
Give light to my eyes before the dark takes hold

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Verse]
I feared I would sleep the sleep of death
While my foes rejoiced when I fell
They said they had overcome me
But your truth is stronger than my distress

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Bridge]
No darkness can hide your face from me
Your steadfast love remains
You have dealt bountifully with me
In the depth of the storm

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Outro]
He has done good to me
He has dealt bountifully with me
